public_rationale: Marcus said accuracy falling off on larger multiplication problems had been seen repeatedly, in both older and newer models. For older models, Dziri et al. (2023) found that GPT-3, ChatGPT and GPT-4 went from near-perfect to zero accuracy as problem size grew. ChatGPT and GPT-4 scored only 55% and 59% on 3x3-digit problems. For newer models, Yuntian Deng's September 2024 evaluation went up to 20x20 digits. It found GPT-4o struggles beyond 4x4 (under 30% accuracy, per TechCrunch), and o1 does well only up to about 9x9. That makes at least two separate evaluations across two model generations, all showing the same fall-off. The claim holds as stated.
limitations: The Deng results are a researcher's social-media post plus a news report, not a peer-reviewed paper.
Some models do better at larger sizes than others; the claim is about the trend, not about one threshold.
